title: fynkel.Skin
description: Makes the entity's `MeshRenderer` a skinned draw (M3-19): the mesh's vertices carry joint weights into `skin` (an imported glTF `skin/<s>`), whose joints are resolved by name to entities under `skeleton`, an object reference (Unity's `rootBone`, ADR-0035) — the mesh entity's tree root when None; a destroyed skeleton leaves the bind pose. Every frame the renderer gets one matrix per joint from those entities' (interpolated) world matrices; a joint that does not resolve stays in its bind pose. The importer writes this next to the renderer of every skinned node; the world must know the skin (`World::register_skin`; loaders do, `SKIN_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

skeleton.description: The skeleton root object; None for the mesh's tree root.
